description: Pinned third-party parser builds. A hash change invalidates comparison with previously published results.

tools.name: MFTECmd
tools.note: Eric Zimmerman. Framework-dependent .NET 9 build; guest needs the .NET 9 Desktop Runtime.

tools.name: SleuthKit
tools.note: Volume/disk-level parsing (istat, fls, mmls). Cannot parse a standalone $MFT file. A detached .asc signature is published alongside.

tools.name: Mft2Csv
tools.note: Joakim Schicht. GUI-driven: no documented CLI, so it is NOT part of the automated pipeline. Used as a MANUAL SPOT-CHECK on a sample of records per run, recorded in the run notes.

tools.name: Velociraptor
tools.note: Go. Automated second opinion covering all 8 timestamps via VQL parse_mft(). Single static binary, no runtime dependency. A detached .sig is published alongside.

tools.name: DotNetRuntime9
tools.note: MFTECmd is a framework-dependent net9.0 build requiring Microsoft.NETCore.App 9.0. The guest has no internet, so the runtime is staged from the host. Silent install: /install /quiet /norestart

tools.name: VCRedist2015_2022
tools.note: mft_dump is a Rust x86_64-pc-windows-msvc build and needs vcruntime140.dll, which is absent on a clean Windows install. Without it the process exits 0xC0000135 (STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND) with no message. Silent install: /install /quiet /norestart

tools.name: mft_dump
tools.note: Rust. Single static binary, no runtime dependency; used for automated re-verification of archived $MFT files.
